source.doc: z-range of section points lying within 0.05 mm of the nose u (the vertical land) in transverse plane sections, bed datum z=785.8; tip radius by least-squares circle on horizontal-probe hits (0.02 mm z steps) from land-1.5 to land+2.0 above the land; first pass used the densified cushion polygon and 11 outline vertices.

The first-pass rails.json "nose_land_z": [35.04334518442606, 35.9997829548643] is the wider band including the fillet onsets within 0.05 mm of the nose u; drawing land = 35.15..35.97. Tip fillet: REPLICATED R 1.93 supersedes the first-pass R 1.89 (rails.json nose_tip_circle R 1.8890069163430647, rms 0.064, 11 vertices; 1.874..1.925 over 22 stations) - the vertex-only fit under-weights the arc. A0 CU-09 [35.15, 35.97] confirmed. Datum note from the replication record: the mesh cloth-top plane is z=785.828, so every bed-relative height here carries +0.028 vs the true cloth surface (negligible).
